description: This file defines a custom Glide module for an Android application, enabling cache clearing functionality for Glide image loading library.

classes.name: CustomAppGlideModule
classes.description: A custom Glide module that provides a static method to clear Glide's memory and disk cache.

methods.name: registerComponents
methods.description: Overrides the method to register components with Glide; currently calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: A static method to clear Glide's memory and disk cache, executed on the UI thread and background thread respectively.
